arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unlabelled_transactions FROM transactions t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fraud_labels f WHERE f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT))
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions that have no matching row in fraud_labels, across the full 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 range.
assumptions: 'No fraud label at all' means no row exists in fraud_labels for the transaction, regardless of is_fraud value.
No date filter applied; covers the whole data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
